report_name: Rhysida Ransomware Gang Hits Anne Arundel County, Steals 2.6TB of Data

threat_actors.name: Rhysida
threat_actors.description: The Rhysida ransomware gang claimed responsibility for an August 2026 cyberattack on Anne Arundel County, Maryland. The group exfiltrated 2.6TB of sensitive data and listed it on their dark web leak site, demanding a ransom of 25 BTC.
threat_actors.goals: Financial extortion of victims through data theft and ransomware deployment.

attack_patterns.name: Data Encrypted for Impact
attack_patterns.description: The Rhysida gang deployed their ransomware to encrypt systems within Anne Arundel County's network as the final stage of their attack.

attack_patterns.name: Exfiltration Over Alternative Protocol
attack_patterns.description: The Rhysida gang exfiltrated 2.6TB of sensitive data from Anne Arundel County's network before deploying ransomware.

attack_patterns.name: Valid Accounts
attack_patterns.description: The threat actor moved laterally within the county's network to identify valuable data, likely using compromised valid accounts.

malware.name: Rhysida Ransomware
malware.description: Ransomware used by the Rhysida gang to encrypt systems in Anne Arundel County. The malware is associated with the file extension '.rhysida' and the ransom note 'CriticalBreachDetected.pdf'.

tools.name: PsExec
tools.description: The PsExec.exe tool was noted as a process-level observable associated with the attack, likely used for lateral movement or remote execution.

identities.name: Anne Arundel County, Maryland
identities.description: A county in Maryland, USA, with nearly 600,000 residents, which was targeted by the Rhysida ransomware gang. The attack resulted in the theft of 2.6TB of data, including medical, payroll, and jail records.

infrastructure.name: Rhysida dark web leak site
infrastructure.description: A dark web site used by the Rhysida gang to publish stolen data from victims and pressure them into paying ransoms. Anne Arundel County was listed on this site.

indicators.name: Rhysida Ransomware File Extension
indicators.pattern:
title: Rhysida Ransomware File Extension
id: 7f5a9c1b-8d2e-4f6a-b3c1-9e8d7f6a5b4d
status: experimental
description: Detects files being created or renamed with the .rhysida extension, which is indicative of the Rhysida ransomware.
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-10-17
references:
  - https://cybernews.com/news/rhysida-maryland-government-data-breach/
tags:
  - attack.t1486
level: critical
logsource:
  category: file_event
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    TargetFilename|endswith: '.rhysida'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the creation of files with the '.rhysida' extension, a key indicator of Rhysida ransomware activity.
